text: analysis project uses embr/cmdstanr. kelpbio re-implements models using rstan/rstantools (pre-compiled Stan, cmdstan required runtime). Key analysis scripts: kelpbio works site-year resolution — month dimension (analysis models’ month effects dropped). Biomass combines six models via size-integration (density × E_size[weight(diameter)] × ratios), density × weight; see predictions spec decisions/prediction-engine.md. wetdry/carbon become intercept-Beta (REs) month dropped.

title: CLAUDE.md — kelpbio
text: Prefix: exported functions use kb_ Validation: exported function arguments validated chk; user-facing messages via cli. Bespoke internal validators follow bboutools .vld_/.chk_ split: .vld_<name>() R/vld.R pure predicate returning logical scalar (minimal args, messaging); .chk_<name>() partner R/chk.R calls either returns input invisibly aborts via cli. Every bespoke .chk_ matching .vld_ (multi-arg chk:: bundles like .chk_sampler_args() exempt: single predicate pair). .chk_ may layer chk:: primitives re-derive granular messages one boolean coarse. internal (leading dot, unexported). Example: Documentation: roxygen2 markdown; @inheritParams shared parameters. Write every exported topic first-time reader (see ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md): development/decision/debate context, rare edge cases, testing/developer jargon (e.g. snapshot-safe, load_all() gotchas) reader-facing docs; route rationale code comments, decisions/, change’s design.md. One job per section: description (first paragraph) one short statement function produces, return mechanics re-listing arguments; @details covers non-obvious behaviour caller get wrong (edge cases, argument interactions, default’s user-visible tradeoff rather mechanism behind ); @return sole home returned type/structure invisibly/side-effect note (validators return input invisibly called side effect). Description voice: extractor/accessor topics use noun phrase naming yield (fitted, tidy, glance, log_lik, posterior_*, samples); action functions use imperative (fit, predict, plot, check, construct). Arguments: name type, dispatch: data input data, fit fit object (including package’s generics kb_stancode/samples), predictions kb_predictions frame. S3 methods must keep generic’s first-arg name (object base/stats/rstantools/ggplot2, x generics/universals), R CMD check enforces, object/x/fit naming fit expected, inconsistency fix. Multi-word names snake_case (new_data, new_levels, conf_level); take ecosystem spelling generic fixes (e.g. transform posterior_linpred). Order follows tidyverse data-descriptors-details shape: primary object, descriptor arguments meant passed positionally (new_data, , diameter, priors), ..., every optional detail knob name-argument ... (new_levels, representative_site, conf_level, estimate, sig_fig, include_random_effects, rhat, esr, sampler config) details set positionally; guard empty ... rlang::check_dots_empty(). summary trio conf_level, estimate, sig_fig keeps order everywhere. @param prose uses chk vocabulary (flag specifying whether ..., whole number ..., number 0 1 ..., string, one ..., data frame ...), names fit argument dispatch class (kb_fit parent-class methods, kb_fit_weight weight-specific ones). Writing (docs, README, vignettes, roxygen, PR/commit text): follow writing style ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; particular em-dashes en-dashes (use hyphens, commas, colons) mid-sentence bold emphasis; concise technical register File layout: one function per file, file named function (kb_fit_weight_nereo() → R/kb_fit_weight_nereo.R). S3 methods grouped one file per generic, named generic (R/print.R holds print.* methods, R/tidy.R tidy.*, etc.). Internal helpers clearly-named files, never catch-utils.R. Testing: testthat 3e; strict 1:1 test mirroring (R/<name>.R ↔︎ tests/testthat/test-<name>.R). Test wrapper, model’s numbers. Snapshot print methods + messages; NEVER snapshot MCMC numerics (test structure + invariants instead). Small pre-built fits tests/testthat/fixtures/ (built rstan::sampling(seed=), set.seed); slow end--end fits skip_on_cran(). Factor pure logic (data/prior assembly) fit functions MCMC-free testing. See decisions/bboutools-api-review.md testing rationale. Code style: tidyverse; lubridate, reshape2, plyr, data.table library() calls package code; use @importFrom pkg::fun() run Stan MCMC session without confirming first; fitting slow
code: # R/vld.R .vld_new_data_weight_nereo <- function(x) {   is.data.frame(x) && "diameter" %in% names(x) } # R/chk.R .chk_new_data_weight_nereo <- function(x, x_name = deparse(substitute(x))) {   if (.vld_new_data_weight_nereo(x)) {     return(invisible(x))   }   if (!is.data.frame(x)) {     cli::cli_abort("{.arg {x_name}} must be a data frame or {.code NULL}.")   }   cli::cli_abort("{.arg {x_name}} must have a {.field diameter} column.") }

title: Summarise a Model Fit — summary.kb_fit
text: print method renders header (likelihood family, fixed- random-effect structure, observation group counts, sampler configuration, convergence verdict), coefficient table, diagnostics footer. compact overview without numeric table, call print() fit . coefficient table reports, per term: estimate posterior point estimate (estimate function; median default). lower, upper conf_level equal-tailed compatibility limits. rhat potential scale reduction factor, comparing - within-chain variance; values near 1 indicate convergence. ess_bulk bulk effective sample size, governing reliability central posterior summaries. ess_tail tail effective sample size, governing reliability interval limits. Population-level coefficients random-effect standard deviations always shown. group-level deviations included include_random_effects = TRUE, following convention summary reports variance hyperparameters rather per-level effects (latter tidy() default).
